verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show a built-in query feature (`{{query ...}}` simple queries, created with `/query`) for asking questions of the knowledge base, and properties exist as a structured notion (e.g. `publish:: true`). The pack never shows querying by property values or rendering results as live tables, boards or list views. Missing for 10: evidence of property-based query filters, table/board/list view rendering of query results, advanced query documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
